name: Neo-SPC voice architecture profiles
principles: A voice budget is a ceiling and orchestration plan, not a permanent density target.
Core identity must survive as melody, bass and harmony before ensemble layers are added.
Additional voices must have a declared role: core, ensemble, ornament, texture, percussion or effects.
Peak density should be section-dependent; 24-32 voices are reserved for formal arrivals, counterpoint or large ensembles.

profiles.use: hardware-aware sketches and intentionally sparse retro cues
small ensembles, layered leads and richer percussion
orchestral, choral, dense action and multi-layer electronic cues
classical counterpoint, large choir/orchestra and exceptional climaxes
